clips.caption:
Every book on wealth creation skips the same ingredient, Kevin Trudeau says - the one that matters most.

He spent a week with forty extremely wealthy men in California. One of them personally controls roughly $750 billion. Asked what they all had in common, everyone lit up like it was obvious.

The answer was giving. Not just giving more in total - giving a higher percentage of what they have than people who earn an average income.

Before you say "well, they can afford it," remember: percentage, not amount, is the real habit.

What percentage of what you earn actually goes out the door?
